questions.question:
A: Excuse me, how can I ______ to the post office?
B: Go straight for two blocks. It's on your right.
questions.explanation: 「如何到達某地」的固定句型為 'How can I get to [place]?'。
questions.commonMisconception: 學生可能將 go to 與 get to 混淆。在此句型中助動詞後方需用原形 get。

questions.question: Don't turn left. Go ______! You will see the bank.
questions.explanation: 直走 (Go straight) 是方向指引中最基礎的動詞詞彙。
questions.commonMisconception: 拼寫錯誤。

questions.question: Turn ______ at the corner. The park is next to the bookstore.
questions.explanation: 在轉角轉彎，選項中只有 left (左轉) 代表轉向動作。
questions.commonMisconception: 分不清左轉與直走。

questions.question:
A: How ______ I get to the bank?
B: You can take a bus.
questions.explanation: 詢問「如何能夠」抵達，使用助動詞 can。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 How do you go to school 習慣影響誤選 do，雖然語法通但 get to 句型常用 can。

questions.question: The hospital is ______ your left.
questions.explanation: 描述「在某人的左/右側」，介係詞固定使用 on (on your left)。
questions.commonMisconception: 介係詞誤用。

questions.question:
A: Do I turn right at the museum?
B: No, ______ right. Turn left.
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句的結構為 'Don't + 原形動詞'。
questions.commonMisconception: 否定結構不完整或語法錯誤。

questions.question:
A: Is the library far from here?
B: No, it isn't. Just ______ straight for one minute.
questions.explanation: 祈使句指示方向，使用原形動詞開頭。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 one minute 誘導而誤用進行式或單三。

questions.question: There ______ a post office across from the school.
questions.explanation: There be 句型，主詞 a post office 為單數，故用 is。
questions.commonMisconception: 主謂不一致。

questions.question: I want ______ to the supermarket to buy some apples.
questions.explanation: want 之後接帶 to 的不定詞。後面另一個 to 是場所介係詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 重複出現的不定詞符號與介係詞混淆。

questions.question:
Go straight. Turn left at the bookstore. The post office is next to the bookstore.
Question: Where is the post office?
questions.explanation: 文中明確表示 'The post office is next to the bookstore'。
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊提取錯誤。

questions.question:
The bank is on your left. If you see the park, you went (走過頭) too far.
Question: Is the bank after the park?
questions.explanation: 看到公園代表走過頭，表示銀行應在公園「之前」。
questions.commonMisconception: 方位與先後順序邏輯處理不當。

questions.question:
A: How can I get to Tainan?
B: You can take the train. The train station is across from the museum.
Question: Where is the train station?
questions.explanation: 文中說明火車站位在博物館對面。
questions.commonMisconception: 受首句 Tainan 影響而選了錯誤地點。

questions.question:
The supermarket is two blocks from here. One block is 100 meters.
Question: How far (多遠) is the supermarket?
questions.explanation: 兩個街口，一街口 100 公尺，總共 200 公尺。
questions.commonMisconception: 數學單位換算與文本理解結合力不足。

questions.question:
Amy: 'I'm at the library. It's across from the park.'
Sam: 'I'm at the park now.'
Question: Can Sam see the library?
questions.explanation: 兩人在對面，Sam 在公園，自然能看到對面的圖書館。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法建構相對視野的空間感。

questions.question: ______ at the second (第二個) corner.
questions.explanation: 祈使句動詞開頭，turn right 為動作習慣表達。
questions.commonMisconception: 受中文「右轉」倒置影響誤選 Right turn。

questions.question: The light (紅綠燈) is red. You ______ go straight.
questions.explanation: 紅燈不應直走，使用否定助動詞 shouldn't。
questions.commonMisconception: 交通法規常識與否定詞應用。

questions.question: The post office is closed (關門) today. I ______ get there tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 今天關門，打算明天再去，使用未來式 will。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 today 影響誤用法。需注意前後句意轉折。

questions.question: In Taiwan, many street names use directions, like ______ Road.
questions.explanation: 台灣路名常包含方位，如 中山「北」路 (North Road)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備在地地標文化的英文化認知。

questions.question:
Excuse me, where is the office?
It's in the main building (主棟), on the ______ floor.
questions.explanation: 描述樓層使用序數詞 first (一樓)。
questions.commonMisconception: 基數詞與序數詞用法混淆。

questions.question:
A: Is the hospital next to the bank?
B: No, it's across from the bank.
Question: Is the hospital far from the bank?
questions.explanation: 在對面 (across from) 通常代表只隔一條街，並不「遙遠」(far)。
questions.commonMisconception: 對距離形容詞與方位詞的語感不一致。
